name: feedback-station
title_zh: 手机扫码打勾，测试反馈落本地盘
tagline_zh: 真机测试别再截图传群聊了。测试者手机逐条勾选通过/未通过，附截图录屏，新 Bug 新需求随手提。
tagline_en: Stop screenshot-storming group chats. Testers tick pass/fail on phones, attach media, file bugs & requests—agent.
desc_en: 真机测试反馈闭环——在电脑上起一个局域网反馈站,测试者用手机逐条勾「通过 / 未通过 / 未测试」、附截图录屏、提新 Bug 与新需求,数据落本地磁盘,智能体直接读盘处理。每批交付测试版要发复验清单时、用户说"测完了 / 看反馈 / 起反馈站 / 接入反馈站"时调用。通用 Agent Skill,不绑定宿主:Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等都能用。Real-device test feedback loop: start a LAN feedback site on the computer; testers mark each checklist item pass / fail / not tested on their phones, attach screenshots and recordings, file new b
why_zh: 反馈不经过聊天记录中转，直接落成本地结构化数据；智能体按盘上文件就能复验、归类、出清单。
why_en: Feedback skips chat-log limbo, lands as structured local files; the agent reads disk to verify, triage, and list—no manual.
limit_zh: 只覆盖测试反馈采集与落盘，不含缺陷追踪、权限管理或多项目隔离；需测试者与电脑在同一局域网，且电脑端保持服务运行。
limit_en: Covers feedback collection & disk storage only—no issue tracker, auth, or multi-project isolation; needs LAN access and the host service running.
title_en: Phone checklists, feedback lands on local disk
